items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: Furry, I've got a guitar at home that's a broad neck guitar.

ctx.x: I was, uh, trying to find a little piece of steel that I played with all the songs.
Furry, I've got a guitar at home that's a broad neck guitar. It's, uh, it might be a little bit strange for you because it's got these softer strings. It's not metal strings.
You know, you've got them nylon strings. Yeah. Oh, that's a good guitar, that's right.
